ITEM 1 | Pale green-white cucumber slices, thin rounds with dark green skin edge and pale flesh, two wedge-shaped half-moon pieces at top of plate, glossy and moist, about 2 cm thick, roughly 6 cm across each, sitting above the carrot pile | 40
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange carrot, fine matchstick strands about 0.2 cm thick and 5 cm long, bright orange, matte with slight moisture, loosely piled in a mound covering about one-fifth of the plate, 1.5 cm high | 45
ITEM 3 | Whole red cherry tomato, smooth glossy red skin, round, about 3 cm diameter, sitting near the upper middle of the plate beside a Brussels sprout | 20
ITEM 4 | Whole red cherry tomato, smooth glossy red skin, round, about 2.5 cm diameter, located lower right of the carrots next to a green pepper piece | 15
ITEM 5 | Cherry tomato, smooth glossy red skin, round, about 3 cm diameter, placed in the center right of the plate beside a green pepper strip | 18
ITEM 6 | Two small green Brussels sprouts, dense round heads about 2.5 cm across, dull green with slightly charred, browned edges and a cut base, sitting on the right side of the plate near the tomatoes | 25
ITEM 7 | Single green Brussels sprout, dense round head about 2.5 cm across, dark green with blackened, charred patches and a cut base, lying on the right side of the plate below the tomato | 15
ITEM 8 | Green bell pepper pieces, flat glossy strips with curved edges and thin green skin, about 1 cm thick, pale green flesh at cut edges, arranged in a cluster at the bottom of the plate, slightly wilted, covering about one-tenth of the plate | 35
